description: Triage of one batch of papers against the reader's interest profile. One entry per input paper.

results.description: Exactly one entry for every paper in the input, in input order. No missing, repeated or invented ids.

id.description: The paper's id, copied verbatim from the input.

one_line.description: Why the paper matters or doesn't for this reader's profile. Language: the one named in the system prompt's Output section; for ru, a Russian sentence with technical terms, method, model and dataset names kept in English; for en, English. English abstracts do not change this. Written before the score; no filler, no restated title.

tags.description: 1-5 lowercase tags from the prompt's vocabulary, for grouping only.

score.description: Integer 0-10 read from the prompt's scoring table, relative to this reader's profile.
